text:
laura: PR #34321 is blocked by CI — failing test 'embed-index-chunking' on win-x64. Anyone able to take a look? Logs attached.
mike: looking now. Quick log snippet:
```
ERROR: Timeout after 300s building shard 7
...build step stalled at kv-merge
```
anya: passed earlier on same commit, so likely nondet/infrastructure. @ci-bot can we queue a targeted rerun for shard 7?
ci-bot: Targeted rerun queued for shard 7 on PR 34321 (agent: win-x64). Status: queued
sam: let's try the targeted rerun first. If it flakes again, propose a temporary skip with a follow-up fix from jordan.
jordan: I can author the skip but prefer bisecting. Any seed/randomness info?
mike: test uses time-based RNG. I estimate repro ~1/20. I have a branch adding `--stable-seed` that reduces flakiness.
ci-bot: Rerun completed: shard 7 PASSED. Note: PR still failing due to macOS snapshot mismatch (ui-snap-218).
laura: damn — snapshot diff is whitespace in table rendering. I can update snapshots if reviewers okay with that. @anya @jordan thoughts?
anya: if it's whitespace-only and reproducible, update the snapshot and file a follow-up to normalize renderer. post the diff link and tag me.
jordan: +1 to update now, but schedule renderer fix in next sprint.
mike: laura, go ahead. After updating, trigger the mac-snapshot job or full CI.
laura: updated snapshots in commit 9c3a4f2. @ci-bot please run mac-snapshot job.
ci-bot: mac-snapshot job queued.
oncall: FYI if it flakes again ping me and I'll provision extra win workers for reruns.
ci-bot: mac-snapshot job PASSED. PR merged by laura. :tada:
